en: If they do not submit to these words of mine,
If they gather their livestock and people,
And do not bring tribute before me,
If they do not bow their heads and say, “We submit,”
If they do not stand with heads bowed,
To the ridge where battle will be fought,
To the place where slaughter will be made,
Let every one of those Kyrgyz come,
To the field where they will be crushed!
They say Kenen arose from the Kyrgyz,
They say his myriad troops stand ready,
They say he is a hero surpassing the world.
I continued from what was handed down,
uncertainty_note: Provisional manuscript reading; cursive letterforms or witness alignment remain uncertain.

en: I asked those who knew,

uncertainty_note: Provisional manuscript reading; cursive letterforms or witness alignment remain uncertain.

en: Kermekash, loveliest of maidens,
Tell him to surrender his Kermekash,
Remaining alive and never extinguished,
The peerless swift horse Kertulpar,
To Padishah Chyngteñir,
Tell him to offer both as tribute!
If he does not submit to the words spoken,
That wretched Kenen,
If he does not give his horse and daughter,
I will set embers to his farthest reaches,
If he incurs my wrath,
I will destroy him and take his head,
If my fury truly seizes me,
If he refuses what has been said,
If he does not truly submit and bow his head,
If he does not come as a subject,
I will not let him turn his plough,
I will not let him turn to his livelihood,
Though he walks upon the face of the earth,
Though he scatters seed and grain,
I will not let him make a living!
I will not let them range freely and reap,

en: If my weighty fury takes hold,
I will slaughter his countless myriads,
I will leave them wandering like victims of yellow sickness,
I will give them an affliction that never leaves.
Shooting from ridge after ridge,
I will erase every last remnant of them,
Tell him to submit to these words.
